programmes.name: MA Anthropology
programmes.sourceStatus: AI-assisted official-source page check; independent review pending
programmes.notesEn: September 2027 is stated in the department body, although its heading still says Fall 2026. Five dated rounds are recorded; rolling assessment may fill places early, and consideration after 31 December depends on places. Full-time annual tuition is provisional. Part-time charging basis conflicts across official pages, so no numeric part-time fee or two-year total is assumed. No numeric undergraduate GPA or automatic English waiver is inferred. Re-read all six listed CUHK sources on 24 October 2026 before the second round. The MA is taught coursework without a thesis and does not require previous anthropology study; this does not establish a universal subject whitelist. Online application, payment and supporting-document deadlines must be considered together; the department also requests mailed evidence. Required courses are in English, while some electives are Cantonese. Mixed MA/MPhil/PhD FAQ content, its older update footer and the Fall 2026 heading are not used to import research admission, writing-sample or funding conditions.

offerings.deadlineNote: Five rounds: 30 Sep, 31 Oct, 30 Nov, 31 Dec 2026; 31 Jan 2027. Rolling assessment may fill places early; applications after 31 Dec are considered subject to places. No round opening dates, intraday cutoffs or live availability are assumed.

offerings.deadlineNote: Five rounds: 30 Sep, 31 Oct, 30 Nov, 31 Dec 2026; 31 Jan 2027. Rolling assessment may fill places early; applications after 31 Dec are considered subject to places. No round opening dates, intraday cutoffs or live availability are assumed.

rules.noteEn: Recognised bachelor degree normally at least second-class honours or average B, OR an accepted professional/similar qualification equivalent to a bachelor degree; university judgement, not a numeric GPA conversion. The department says exceptional lower-grade cases may be considered with a justification and individual assessment, not guaranteed admission. No general numeric GPA, honours-only rejection or anthropology-major prerequisite is inferred.

A Hong Kong university degree or a degree taught in English may support the general English route, subject to additional evidence and university acceptance. The central page lists TOEFL Internet-based/Home Edition and IELTS Academic Test Centre/Online; no compulsory single-sitting condition or IELTS sub-score is established here. GMAT/Focus verbal, specified school examinations and accepted English-examined professional qualifications are alternative evidence, not automatic waivers. TOEFL/IELTS two years from test; GMAT five years. Applicable validity anchor, programme-specific evidence and university acceptance remain manual; no expiry countdown from today.

One-page purpose statement; two references (online or hard copy); official transcript/grading and degree evidence; English proof where needed; applicable identity and qualification-verification documents. The department application page requests an online application plus mailed supporting documents to the Division BY THE DEADLINE; the FAQ says application, payment and all supporting documents are due by the deadline. Confirm the exact current receipt/delivery instructions, including online references, rather than assuming a payment or form alone completes the file. Its stale Fall 2026 heading remains a discrepancy. This website does not collect, mail or submit these documents.

rules.labelEn: Taught MA scope, delivery language and mixed FAQ boundaries
rules.noteEn: The MA is designed for people without previous anthropology study, is entirely coursework and requires no thesis. The FAQ's MPhil anthropology/social-science background, research thesis/writing-sample discussion and PhD supervisor/quota/deadline material are not MA admission gates. All required MA courses are in English; some electives are in Cantonese, with sufficient English options but more limited choice for non-Cantonese speakers. No Cantonese test or prior anthropology degree is introduced as a mandatory rule. Research stipends and fellowship figures are not MA fee deductions, and no external funding or housing entitlement is promised. The FAQ still carries a 1 September 2025 update footer despite its 2027/28 tuition text, so it does not resolve the provisional/part-time fee conflict.

Two preliminary undergraduate terms (Terms 7 and 8) precede the MArch and have separate fee/applicability questions; track placement is not automatic.

Relevant work experience and its duration must support professional-course requirements, but no numeric minimum years is published here. Programming experience (such as Python, JavaScript, C++ or C#) and Rhino 3D, Grasshopper and digital-fabrication preparation require manual assessment. Advanced standing for a structured internship requires a separate request; it is not automatic.

TOEFL or IELTS evidence is required where the prior degree was not taught in English. The consulted admissions page does not state a numeric minimum, a test-validity anchor or an updated TOEFL scale cutoff.
